paper.title: LLM-generated implementations of classic graph algorithms

review.notes: Hand-written extraction for run-plan PoC (Analyst skipped). Values are NetworkX ground truth.

merged.research_question: Can an AI system implement classic graph algorithms correctly from algorithm specifications?
merged.paper_overview: Five classic graph algorithms are implemented from detailed specifications. Each algorithm is tested on representative test cases with computed ground truth.
merged.methodology: Engineer receives algorithm specifications including input/output formats and constraints. Engineer writes implementations. Validator tests each algorithm on test cases and compares outputs to expected behavior.
merged.notes: Test validation measures correctness: output format matches spec, node orderings are structurally valid, numeric metrics within ±2% tolerance.
